title: Pacto dev-world state manifest
description: The only identity contract shared by pacto-dev-env, pacto-app, and pacto-bot-api. Describes one dev world: its cast, its relay and chain endpoints, and the deployment artifacts that back it. Contains no secret material; materialized secrets live in the gitignored sidecar described by secrets-sidecar.schema.json. A breaking change here is a three-repo change, which is what manifestVersion exists to make loud.

manifestVersion.description: Integer contract version. Every consumer declares the minimum version it accepts and the maximum it understands; a manifest outside that window is refused in either direction rather than partially consumed.

personas.description: The cast. Every entry is derived from the committed recipe and is sandbox-only by construction.

id.description: Identifier of the committed derivation recipe, e.g. pacto-dev-world/v1. Changing the recipe id changes the whole cast.

public.description: Always true. The recipe travels with the repository, so every key it derives is public by construction (KD9). This field exists so a consumer cannot read a manifest without being told that.

name.description: Human-readable world label, used in squad names and log lines.

relayEndpoint.description: The single Nostr relay this world routes through. pacto-app receives this as PACTO_TRUSTED_RELAYS.

deploymentArtifacts.description: Repo-relative paths to deployment artifacts backing this world, keyed by artifact name (governance, squad, ...). Consumed by the local-chain address import.

endpoint.description: JSON-RPC endpoint of the chain backing this world.

chainId.description: Chain id the artifacts were deployed against. A mismatch against the running chain is a loud refusal, not a fallback.

name.description: Stable persona name. Also the derivation label, so renaming a persona re-derives its identity.

role.description: What this persona is for in the world, independent of its on-chain squad role.

npub.description: Bech32 Nostr public key derived from the recipe.

ethAddress.description: Ethereum address derived from the persona's mnemonic at m/44'/60'/0'/0/0, matching pacto-app's phrase-derived v1 EVM key.

botId.description: Identity id in pacto-bot-api.toml. Bots act as this persona.

squadRole.description: Role this persona holds in the world's squad.

sandboxOnly.description: Always true. Marks the identity unusable outside a locally-routed sandbox; pacto-app refuses to log in with a sandbox-only identity while any non-local relay is resolved (R25). An identity without this mark fails validation, so the refusal cannot be dodged by omission.

recipe.description: Recipe id this identity came from. Must match the manifest-level recipe id.

label.description: Per-persona label fed to the derivation. Same recipe plus same label always yields the same identity.
